concerns: Idempotency: if README.md already ends with the marker line, the implementer makes no change and reports it already present (spec Errors table).
Exactly one file (README.md) may change; any second file changed fails requirement 'Exactly one file changes'.

acceptance.command: cd -- "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" && git grep -c "Legion Stage 3 smoke marker" README.md
acceptance.criterion: README.md at the smoke branch head ends with a final line reading exactly "Legion Stage 3 smoke marker."
acceptance.negativeControl: Before the edit (or grepping a wrong marker string), the same command prints 0 or errors, proving the check discriminates.
acceptance.surface: The README.md file on the issue's smoke branch head (the real repository file, viewed on the PR / checked out at head) — the production-like surface for a documentation marker.

plan.goal: Append one marker line to sjawhar/legion-smoke README.md so the Legion workflow is proven end-to-end on a real file change.

fileLevelWork: Edit only README.md at the repository root. Append one line `Legion Stage 3 smoke marker.` as the final line of the file, preserving the existing trailing content and a terminating newline.
Error handling per spec: if README.md already ends with the marker line, make no change and report it already present; if README.md does not exist, create it with the marker line as its only content.
Change exactly one file. No source, routes, config, or data-flow files are touched. Do NOT commit any .legion/ or plan/spec file into the PR beyond each phase's own handoff commit.
ordering: 1. Implementer: edit README.md, verify locally with the acceptance command (expect 1), write .legion/implement.json with a proof entry, create bookmark legion/S393466070-1, push, open PR whose body contains `Dispatch: S393466070-1`.
2. Tester: verify the implementer's proof by re-running the acceptance command at head, add own proof, write .legion/test.json.
3. Reviewer: verify the one-file diff and acceptance-command output on GitHub, review the PR.

verificationEvidence.implement: Acceptance command `git grep -c "Legion Stage 3 smoke marker" README.md` returns 1 at the pushed head; recorded as the implement proof with head SHA and a negative control.
verificationEvidence.integration: Merger confirms no changes above the approved head except allowed process artifacts, then publishes READY.
verificationEvidence.review: Reviewer confirms the PR diff changes exactly README.md by exactly one appended line and the acceptance command returns 1.
verificationEvidence.test: Tester re-runs the same command at head, confirms 1, and confirms the diff touches only README.md.

implement: none: looked through all agent skills available in this session (dispatch, envoy, legion-architect, legion-controller, legion-oracle, legion-retro, legion-worker); none drives editing a plain README.md markdown line. legion-worker governs the phase-worker process itself, not the README edit. The edit is a one-line append handled with the ordinary edit/write file tools.
review: none: no code-review skill applies to a single documentation line; the reviewer verifies the one-file diff and the acceptance command output on GitHub directly. legion-retro/legion-worker cover process, not markdown review.
test: none: no repository test skill exists for this smoke sandbox; the sole acceptance is verified by running the shell command `git grep -c "Legion Stage 3 smoke marker" README.md` at the smoke branch head, which needs no skill. No unit/e2e harness applies to a docs marker.

workflowRecommendation: single implementer; trivial one-file docs change, no parallelism
